description: This file contains server-side logic for the StartExam page in an online examination system. It manages user session validation, dynamic course list population based on user semester, exam selection, and navigation to specific exam pages after checking if the student has already taken the exam.

classes.name: StartExam
classes.description: Code-behind class for the StartExam.aspx page, handling page load, button clicks, and grid selections for starting exams, based on user session and database data.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event; verifies user session, retrieves user semester info, and populates course dropdown list accordingly.

methods.name: startB_Click
methods.description: Handles the exam start process; determines exam type, checks for existing questions, sets session variables, and navigates to the appropriate exam page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and redirects to login page.

methods.name: GridView1_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Handles selection of theory exams; checks if the student already took the exam, and if not, prepares the starting question number and navigates to the exam.

methods.name: GridView2_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Handles selection of MCQ exams; similar to the above, but for MCQ type exams.
